Test build of GameNative's Proton 11.0-2 for Android (arm64ec) with the GE-Proton11-7 patches, userspace ntsync and the Material 3 desktop. **Install into a new container.**

## What's new

- **Base: GameNative Proton 11.0-2** (`proton-11.0-2-20260928`): Valve's Proton 11.0 with GameNative's Android port; ntsync uses `/dev/ntsync` when the device has it, otherwise userspace ntsync.
- **GE-Proton11-7 patches**: GE's game fixes, hotfixes and Proton-GE additions that fit this base (55 patches; not wine-staging or the Wayland stack).
- **Wine MR 12262**: restoring a thread context keeps the host's CPSR bits, such as SSBS, instead of overwriting them (Wine bug 60405).
- **ntsync fix**: a wait no longer fails when another thread closes the last handle to the object, and abandoned mutexes are reported.
- **Fixed: crash with ntsync after a while** (`anon_mmap_alloc` assertion in `virtual.c`, seen in Sekiro): a game with more than about 3,000 handles no longer aborts. It came from the ntsync fix above and is also in the GE-Proton 11.0-5 Material 3 build.
- **Material 3**: desktop, programs, pill buttons and Files, as in the GE-Proton 11.0-5 Material 3 build.

## Downloads

- `proton-wine-11.0-2-ge-ntsync-m3-arm64ec.wcp.xz`: Winlator CMOD & Ludashi
- `proton-11.0-2-ge-ntsync-m3-arm64ec.wcp`: GameNative / Bannerlator / WinNative

`versionName` is `11.0-2-arm64ec` with versionCode 4, so it installs next to GameNative's own 11.0-2.

## Notes

- Not tested on a device yet. If a game misbehaves, try `PROTON_NO_NTSYNC=1`.
- `WINE_TASKBAR_STYLE=xp` or `classic` switches to the other desktop styles.

Based on [GameNative/proton-wine](https://github.com/GameNative/proton-wine), [GE-Proton](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom), [The412Banner's XP desktop](https://github.com/The412Banner/proton-wine) and [GameNative/ntsync-android](https://github.com/GameNative/ntsync-android). [Details](https://github.com/Vauzi-17/proton-wine/blob/claude/proton-10-ntsync-compile-20dq12/gamenative-ntsync/README.md).
